Craft, decraft, customize items and absorb strength from weakened enemies.

Active
[Active - Press] Crafting: Opens a crafting GUI that also has an option to Decraft items into their base components. Second tab is a combination of anvil (without renaming) and grindstone (be able to select what enchantments to remove). Using the anvil function to combine enchantments allows it to bypass the vanilla cap of obtainable levels of an enchant By a max of 2 Levels above Vanilla Max.
Active: [Active - Press] Separate: When used on mobs with an EP below 75% of the player, steal one skill of type Common / Extra. When used on oxidized copper, strip it. When used on ore blocks, it gives the player the ore and leaves a stone/deepslate block in its place. When used on suspicious sand/gravel instantly separate item. When used while not looking at anything, remove status effects (unless it’s a beneficial skill effect) from the user. When used while sneaking and looking at subordinate/ally, remove status effects from them instead including severance [Costs 100 MP each effect level removed].
Active: [Active - Press] Synthesize: When used, if the user is looking at a Charybdis Core, gain skills and EP based on the Core’s state. If the player is looking at a mob tagged Spiritual that is at 25% hp or lower, the mob perishes and the player gains all the skills and EP of the mob, only works once per mob type. (Cannot be a summoned spirit, has to be found in the wild)
Spiritual mobs currently include:

Boosts the power of Ice abilities by a decent amount.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Boost - All ice abilities/spells do 2x more damage

Boosts the power of Ice abilities by a great amount.

Passive
[Passive] Boost - All ice abilities/spells do 4x more damage.

Become the monster you were meant to be. Eat all. Analyze, craft and refine items, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.

Toggle has no effect ATM
Active
[Active - Press] - Predation: On use, creates a black mist (breath) in a 2 block radius in front of the player. If it comes into contact with a mob, deals 10 damage and drains 100 MP, with a 10% chance to gain one random intrinsic, common, extra, or resistance skill from the target. If an enemy is killed by Predation, gains all of their intrinsic, common, extra, and resist skills. With Mastery, the mist is capable of eating projectiles. If a magic projectile is eaten, then the player gains that magic (consumed attacks have their ep added to stomach's energy storage). 50% chance to copy eligible magics when consuming a target. Targets killed/corpses eaten have 30% (Configurable) of their ep added to the players, instead of the usual 5% (EP absorb only applies for the first target of that type using Predator) The other 50% will be added to Stomach's energy storage. Shift-activate to toggled on/off consume-block-mode, which will automatically be added to Stomach.
Active: [Active - Press] - Stomach: When activated, grants access to a spatial storage with the size of a chest with 7 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 128 instead of 64.(Use Alt+skill key to change different modes)
Active: [Active - Press] - Isolation: Consumes held item and restores MP similar to Absorb and Dissolve, but with twice the restored MP. If nothing is held and the player is looking at a target, remove all negative status effects from that target. If used while empty handed and not looking at a mob, removes all negative status effects from the player [Costs 100MP each effect level removed].
Active: [Active - Press] - Analysis: Opens an analysis GUI functioning similarly to Great Sage's refinement subskill excluding the function for automation and saving item on closing GUI.

You are the calamity. You are the storm, and you are approaching. Strike lightning in all cardinal directions that deal massive Electricity Damage to all those unfortunate to be hit by it.

Active
[Active, Press] Dissonance - Call down a large AOE thunder bolt on the target. Can be used without thundering weather.
Cannot be used if you are not a Dissonance Deity.

In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - On attacking or being attacked, ignores every Dodge, Crit Chance, and Dodge Avoidance abilities.
Cannot be used without being a True Hero.

Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.

Passive
[Passive - True] - Unyield: Once a mob is named by the user, it will gain 1 (2 with Mastery) Unyielding Point each 5s that it’s 30 blocks around the player, this will decrease if the mob is too far away. If a subordinate dies to a damage source not from the owner, the user will gain 10% of the sub’s EP for each 120 points (10 minutes) it has - The maximum amount of EP can gain is 100% = 1200 points (100 minutes).
To gain the fallen Subordinates’ skills/magics/battlewills, the Subordinate needs to have at least 120 points for Skills, Battlewills, Magic, and 600 points for Unique Skills.
Active
[Active - Press] - Backup: Upon activation, at the MP cost equal to 25% of the user’s max MP, spawn an immobile Body with all your EP and no skills at where the user is. When activated again, transfer the user’s soul to where the Body is and spawn a new Body where the user is, swap their Equipments in Armor and Hand slots (other slots are untouched) - Shift activate to remove the Backup Body. If the user dies when there’s a Backup available, automatically transfer them to that Backup (If KeepInventory is off, items in Armor and Hand slots of the user will spawn where they’re supposed to die, else those will spawn where the Backup is). Only works Multi-Dimensionally with Mastery.

Do recon by becoming smaller and more agile while seeing all enemies nearby. Spawn clones, or consume the essence of your enemies to obliterate them in a single strike.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Recon - Cannot toggle when Attack is activated. Reduces player size by half, gives the user +1 Presence Sense level, + 10 Presence Sense Radius (20 with Mastery), highlights all mobs within the sensing radius area in white. Grants a 10% (20% with Mastery) Physical Attack auto-dodge chance.
Active
[Active - Press] - Attack - Cannot activate when Recon is toggled. While holding down, scroll mouse to choose the number of clones to summon, up to 5 clones. Upon release the skill button, reduces player size by half, reduces EP by 50% (lasts until disabled) and spawns the chosen number of clones (shift to have Alex model, else Steve model) with identical stats to the player and 50% EP divided evenly to every clone. Activate again to disable, having EP back to 100%
Active: [Active - Press] - Infinite Eater (Requires Learning) - Requires both Recon and Attack Mode to be inactive. When activated while looking at a target, if their EP is equal to or lower than the user's, they're insta-killed and 50% of the target’s EP is consumed (EP gain only applies for the first target of that type). Costs as much MP as the target’s EP. Will recover magicule when succeeded. Cooldown 10s (5s with Mastery)

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Unless the player's HP reaches 0, instantly regenerate all lost hearts - Costs 100 MP (60 MP with Mastery) per 1 HP

Shoot out a screech of sound which damages physical bodies or use echolocation to highlight nearby entities.

Active
[Active - Press] - Sonic Wave: AoE attack that damages non-spiritual beings - 30 MP - 3s cooldown (1s with Mastery).
Active: [Active - Hold] - Auditory Sense: Sonar mode that highlights nearby noise-making mobs radius 20 in Green - 0 MP
When taking damage from a physical source (punch, sword, axe, etc), during calculation there is a 10% chance to auto-dodge the attack and take 0 Damage.

Create Unique Skills and use them for a limited amount of time.

Anti-Skill
Anti-Skill is a skill only accessible through the Creation subskill. Anti-Skill makes the user immune to Magic, Skills, and Battlewill. When punching a Ranged Barrier, instantly destroy it. When attacking a target when both hand empty (only empty main hand with Creator’s Mastery), remove all barrier points from target and inflict a debuff on target that makes Skills unable to be activated for 4s. (Toggleable with Creators' Mastery)
Active
[Active - Press] - Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Level 1 (2 with Mastery), distance 5 blocks (10 with Mastery), If a target has greater than 2x (4x with Mastery) the player's EP, then only its base stats are shown (Name, HP, SHP, Armor).
Active: [Active - Press] - Skill Creation: When used, allows the player to select one Unique Skill or Anti-Skill, which is then granted to the user for 20 minutes (1 MC day). Cannot create the same skill twice in a row without Mastery. All skills gained via a copy/plunder skill obtained through Creator are considered temporary, and will be removed once the copy/plunder skill is removed
Notes
Any skill created trough Creator that would grant a/multiple secondary skills, will not grant said skills

Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - The player's attacks have a 50% chance to seize 1% of the enemies MP, which restores the player's expended MP.
Active
[Active - Press] - Rob: Only works on opponents with an EP higher than the user. Steals 1 of their skills (Only Common and Extra skills) or Aspectual Magics. 25% chance at success, which raises to 50% with Mastery. Costs 1,000 MP each attempt - 10s cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Copy: Copies 1 of their skills (Only Common, Extra, and Intrinsic skills) or Aspectual Magics of a target. 25% chance at success, which raises to 50% with Mastery. Costs 1,000 MP each attempt - 10s cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Force Takeover (Requires Mastery): Works like Rob, but works on targets weaker than the user and has a 100% success rate. When used on a summon owned by someone with 75% the user's EP or lower, steal that summon. Costs 5,000 MP - 10s cooldown.
